analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a neutral stance for 3 consecutive days. RSI slightly increased from 54.6 to 54.9 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram worsened from 3.5682 to -1.4287, suggesting a potential shift to bearish momentum. The 5-day price change (+4.28%, -3.21%, +1.55%, -1.42%) shows no clear direction. Weekly ADX at 25.8 indicates an existing trend, but the lack of clear daily direction warrants a wait-and-see approach.
